name: Jausenstation Klein Meran
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to Jausenstation Klein Meran in Nesselwängle!**

Nestled in the heart of **Tirol**, this cozy mountain stop invites you to take a break and savor the flavors of the Alps. Whether you're hiking through the breathtaking landscapes of **Nesselwängle** or exploring the nearby peaks, our rustic charm and hearty dishes will recharge your spirit.

Indulge in a classic **Kaiserschmarrn**, fluffy and caramelized, served with fresh fruit or a dollop of apricot jam. For those craving something heartier, our **Käsespätzle**—creamy egg noodles smothered in melted cheese—is a must-try. Pair your meal with a steaming mug of **Tiroler Bergkäse** soup or a refreshing **Apfelschorle** (apple spritzer).

After your meal, warm up with a **Glühwein** (mulled wine) or a frothy **Tiroler Bier** (beer) from the region’s finest breweries. The views from our terrace over the **Lechquellengebirge** mountains are simply unforgettable.

**Jausenstation Klein Meran**—where tradition meets the great outdoors. Come for the food, stay for the memories!
